executiveSummary: Demand is the constraint, not the product. The funnel is fixed (LP crash + price bug resolved 05-19) but there have been no orders in 10 days.
Every channel leaks at the same step — the click-through. Social reach, email opens (33–40%) and SEO impressions all convert to near-zero clicks to site.
EB25 (25% off) expires Friday with zero uses. Decide today: extend, relaunch with a push, or let it lapse.
Manufacturing tracks to ~Jun 25. The live risks are the Minewing assembly PI (cert hold) and the Shopify→NSS integration gap.
